permit.eventDescription: Charged when a permit row is pushed. Empty, not_found, blocked, robots, and error rows are saved and not billed.

proxy.eventDescription: Charged when a request is retried through Apify Proxy after a direct request is blocked. Direct requests are free.

captcha.eventDescription: Charged only when a solver returns a token after the proxy retry is still a challenge. A disabled or unconfigured solve is not billed.
